column7: math:Addition is the binary addition operator (+); the OpenMath arith1 symbol plus is the same operation. closeMatch by reference to the arith1 CD page.
math:Division is the binary division operator (÷); the OpenMath arith1 symbol divide is the same operation. closeMatch by reference to the arith1 CD page.
math:Exponentiation is the exponentiation operator (a^b); the OpenMath arith1 symbol power is the same operation. closeMatch by reference to the arith1 CD page.

math:Interval aligns to the OpenMath interval1 content dictionary, whose symbols interval_cc, interval_oo, interval_oc, and interval_co carry exactly the four closed/open endpoint-inclusion combinations math:lowerInclusion and math:upperInclusion express. closeMatch, full IRI by reference to the CD page (curl-validated HTTP 200).
math:Logarithm is the logarithm operator (log_b of a); the OpenMath transc1 symbol log is the same operation. closeMatch by reference to the transc1 CD page.
math:Multiplication is the binary multiplication operator (×); the OpenMath arith1 symbol times is the same operation. closeMatch by reference to the arith1 CD page.
math:Negation is the unary additive-inverse operator (−x); the OpenMath arith1 symbol unary_minus is the same operation. closeMatch by reference to the arith1 CD page.
math:Root is the root operator (the b-th root of a); the OpenMath arith1 symbol root is the same operation. closeMatch by reference to the arith1 CD page.
math:SpecialFunction aligns to the OpenMath transc1 transcendental-functions CD, the closest OpenMath home for named analysis functions. closeMatch, full IRI by reference (curl-validated HTTP 200).
math:Subtraction is the binary subtraction operator (−); the OpenMath arith1 symbol minus is the same operation. closeMatch by reference to the arith1 CD page.
